balls.text: a full toss outside off stump, Jadhav slogs at it and ends up slicing it over backward point, Irfan covers good ground, running back from the circle and catches the ball as it drops over his head. That's the first time Jadhav's been dismissed this IPL season, in his fifth innings.
right up there in the blockhole, Shukla slogs and slices the ball to point
in the blockhole around off stump, Jadhav slogs across the line and forces it towards midwicket
in the blockhole around off stump, pushed into the off side for a single
a full ball swinging away from the right-hander outside off, Shukla was beaten easily
chipped towards long on for a single, Steyn bowled it full and straight

it's all going pear-shaped for Delhi. Duminy's lost his leg stump. He moved towards the off side to paddle a full ball homing in on leg stump from round the wicket. Duminy missed and leg stump was uprooted. Two run and a wicket in the over. Delhi have been winded.
a full toss outside off stump, Jadhav slogs it towards wide long off
terrific again, in the blockhole outside off stump, Jadhav is beaten once again, not much you can do with those without being set
a wide full toss this time, Jadhav had come out of his crease and was off balance as he swung at that, missed it
awesome from Bhuvi, smack in the blockhole, Jadhav did well to keep it out and play it back to the bowler
nearly in the blockhole from round the wicket, Duminy is cramped and can only push the ball towards mid-on
a slower ball outside off, Duminy drags it through midwicket with the pull, not timed well, he keeps strike
Steyn dives to his right at square leg to cut off Jadhav's flick from outside off stump. Steyn seems to have landed hard on his right shoulder
driven hard but back at the bowler, Irfan had bowled it nearly in the blockhole
a slower ball around off stump, Duminy gets forward and pushes the ball towards mid-on and runs
steps out to a low full toss an drives it through point
good length outside off, Duminy dabs his first ball towards point and runs
hits it hard back towards the bowler

Shukla's holed out for 21 off 22 balls. Henriques bowled a slower ball and Shukla slogged wildly, hitting it straight to Warner at deep midwicket. Both set batsmen have been dismissed and Duminy and Jadhav have to make the most of three overs without having faced a ball each.
drives the ball hard but can't beat cover
slogs at a slower ball outside off and is beaten
a rubbish pull toss and Shukla slams it to the midwicket boundary with a powerful pull

Steyn's taken a blinder on the long-off boundary! Karthik sliced a high full toss down to long off, mis-timing it but hitting it well enough to clear the boundary had Steyn not been right on the edge. Steyn waited, positioned himself, jumped backward, arched his back and then landed back inside the boundary. The ball was in the airspace over the boundary when Steyn caught it
a full toss outside off stump, Karthik moves towards it in his crease and gets cramped for room, ends up mis-timing his pull on the leg side
Karthik chips the ball over the infield at cover and places it into the gap and comes back for two
nearly in the blockhole, Karthik mis-times the drive to cover
mis-times the slog towards long-on, the ball travelled slowly to the fielder so there was time to take two
Shukla walks across his stumps and taps a full length ball towards square leg, can't beat Steyn
Karthik aims for the big slog but gets an inside edge past the keeper's left

a low full toss, Karthik slogs it towards deep midwicket, Warner runs in from the boundary and dives but can't reach the ball in time to take the catch. Sunrisers won't mind that. Five overs to go and still no Duminy.
Karthik dives at the bowler's end to make his crease, Dhawan's throw from cover misses the stumps and concedes an overthrow. Karthik had punched the ball firmly from his crease
a full ball around off stump, driven to long off for another single, another ball Jadhav doesn't play
a full ball on the pads, nearly in the blockhole, Karthik clips it to square leg where the fielder fumbles. Another ball Duminy doesn't play
defended from the crease
steps out and drills the ball down to long on
Karthik plays the reverse paddle sweep, placing it fine past the keeper, Irfan gives chase from short third man and pulls it in with the double-kneed slide
too short, even though the line is outside off, Karthik has enough time to rock back and pull it into the gap between long on and deep midwicket. Hit hard and along the ground
Karthik gets down on one knee and makes superb contact with the slog sweep, the ball soars over deep midwicket, into the stands
flatter ball around off, Karthik stays back and cuts, can't beat point
steps out of his crease and lunges to defend towards cover
Shukla goes back and works the googly from Karn Sharma towards long on
a full ball on middle, Shukla stays in his crease and plays the ball through midwicket
Steyn follows Shukla as he moves outside leg stump and hits the pad to concede a leg bye towards fine leg
Shukla backs away outside leg and plays a wild pull, Steyn bounced him and beat him easily. Karthik wanted to run a bye to the keeper but Shukla sent him back
played behind point with an open face
shot! Karthik moves towards the off side, turns around in his crease, scooping the ball as he does so to clear the fine leg boundary. A page out of AB's book.
Shukla backs away outside leg and tries to slog over midwicket, Steyn follows him and cramps him for room, the ball goes on the off side off the pad
pulled to deep square leg for a single

Mishra mis-judges the catch at fine leg! Karthik swivelled and pulled the short of a length ball in the air, Mishra did not come in enough and in the end the ball fell short of him as he dived forward.
low full toss, Shukla clips it through midwicket
can't really tell if that was a slower ball from Irfan, Karthik moved back and across to work the ball off the pads towards square leg
a length ball outside off, Karthik stays back and cuts to deep point, Warner fires in an awesome throw after sprinting to his left
a full ball outside off, driven through cover for a single
swept through square leg for a single
Shukla finally makes great contact! He jumps out of his crease, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts the googly with the turn over the wide long-on boundary
Shukla slogs across the line and is completely beaten by the legbreak, Ojha takes off the bails and appeals for a stumping. Shukla's back foot is grounded
played towards midwicket for a single
Karthik steps out of his crease but is not to the pitch of the ball, he drives straight and Mishra dives to his left to save runs
played off the pads through square for a single
cut off the back foot but straight to the man at point
stays back to a leg break and dabs it close on the off side, Karthik begins to run but is sent back
slog swept to Steyn on the deep square leg boundary
steps out of the crease but is not to the pitch of the ball. Shukla defends awkwardly
dabbed close on the off side for a single
driven back to the bowler

a huge appeal for lbw after Shukla fails to read the googly and brings his bat own with a rush, he was caught in his crease. Mishra thinks it was pad first, the umpire does not. After seeing replays, it was pad first, and plumb lbw.
he's holed out to deep midwicket! Mayank plonked his foot forward, got down on one knee, and tried to slog the legbreak for six. He only got as far as David Warner on the boundary
that's the googly, Karthik stayed in his crease and defended, the ball goes towards square leg off the inside edge
tossed up outside off, a fuller ball, driven firmly to deep cover
played off the back foot to cover
Mayank leans forward to try and drive a flighted legbreak through cover, he is beaten in the flight and gets a thick outside edge past the catcher at first slip and to the third man boundary
Mayank steps out of his crease to a length ball angled at his body and swings it over midwicket, falls well short of the fielder at deep midwicket
short of a length with width outside off, punched on the up through cover
tries to pull but ends up flat-batting it past the bowler, did not time it well
driven down to long on for a single
a risky run, Mayank had to dive to make his ground and had there been a direct hit he would not have made it. Karthik played it close towards point and ran
played to mid off for a single, the fielder was on the edge of the circle
Mishra responds with the googly that Mayank stays back to and nudges off the pads towards square leg
that's deft from Mayank, he stayed in his crease, waited for the ball to pitch and turn, and cut it so late to beat the fielder at short third man on his left side
pushed into the off side on the front foot

KP's gone! Too hasty too early against the leggie! That's Mishra's 100th IPL wicket too. KP gave Mishra the charge  and tried to loft over the off side, he wasn't to the pitch of the legbreak and mis-timed it straight to Dhawan, who caught it at head height at cover
tossed up slower to Mayank, outside off, he pushes it into the covers for a single
begins with a quick one that slides into the right-hander, Pietersen goes back and manages to squeeze the ball out on the leg side, towards midwicket
a slower ball on a wicket to wicket line, Mayank defends on the leg side
a length ball and Mayank dispatches it, moving forward and lofting the ball on the up with an open face, slicing it over cover for another boundary
good length and straight, Mayank stays in his crease and defends
Henriques shortens his length to a tighter one and KP dabs it close on the leg side for a single
too full again from the bowler and KP blitzes it down the ground with a fierce straight drive, he hit that along the ground and he hit it so hard
that's a friendly half-volley first up, KP meets it on the front foot, outside his crease and clobbers it far over long on with a fearsome swing of the bat
dabbed close on the off side for a quick single
fired down leg side, KP tries to sweep but can't connect
he's cut that from middle and off stump off the back foot! KP goes depp in his crease and makes contact just in time to send the ball racing to the backward point boundary
defended from the crease
there she goes! KP gets on to the front foot to reach a full ball on the bounce and lofts it cleanly over long off, superb execution of an uncomplicated shot
Mayank moves forward and nudges the ball off the pads towards square leg
pushed off the front foot on the leg side for a single
Naman Ojha appeals for a caught behind, Bhuvneshwar not so much. Mayank had a poke outside off at one that seamed away from him from a good length and was beaten
KP tries to smash the ball too hard on the off side but gets a bottom edge into the ground near his feet, he sees Mayank running and responds quickly
KP moves across his crease and plays the ball from around off stump to mid on
defended on the off side
this boundary is not as good. KP tried to drive a good length ball that moved away from him around off stump and the outside edge flew through the vacant slip cordon
shot! KP plays a well-placed square drive, splitting the gap between point and cover. He stayed in his crease and timed it well
short and wide outside off, a loose ball from Steyn, Mayank gets going with a cracking cut, the ball raced through backward point for four
a huge appeal for caught behind after Steyn fires the short ball at the batsman's body but strays down leg side, Mayank tried to pull but missed

caught at cover! De Kock has looked nervy today and he's been dismissed in such a tame way. He got on the front foot to a length ball and drove away from his body, hitting it on the up straight to Rahul at cover
defended back to the bowler
de Kock hoicks across the line at a good length ball that pitches just outside off and bends into the left-hander, that was extremely close to off stump, the ball went between bat and body
driven off the back foot to cover, Steyn is keeping it on a good length around off
he was a goner had Dhawan hit at the bowler's end from mid-on! De Kock pushed firmly to mid-on and set off for a crazy run ... would have been out by yards
good length outside off, de Kock moves forward and plays into the covers
de Kock gets an inside edge into the ground and on to his pad while defending a good length delivery angling across him from over the wicket
KP moves across his crease to flick a full ball but misses and is hit on the pad, they run a leg bye towards midwicket, the fielder fails to pick up cleanly
de Kock uses the straighter line to drive the ball off his pads between mid-on and midwicket, Dhawan chases after it and pulls it in just in time

KP gets on the front foot too early and then dabs towards mid-off and sprints, Henriques is the fielder and he misses at the bowler's end, that would have been close. KP was run out in the previous game too
de Kock stays back to a fuller ball and defends awkwardly, dropping the ball by his feet
too straight again from Steyn, he's trying to swing it from middle and leg away from the right-hander, KP moves across and glances the ball to fine leg
pitches on a good length around off and bends away from KP, who moves forward and shoulders arms
the line is straight once again, de Kock works the ball off his pads through square for more runs
straighter line, on middle stump, de Kock stays in his crease and turns the ball off his pads through square leg
hits a good length around off stump with his first delivery from over the wicket, the ball angles across the left-hander and de Kock lets it go

that's the winning shot! Ojha dispatches a short of a length ball flat over square leg with a pull, and the moment he hit it, everyone knew ... it's taken Sunrisers into the top four in the points table
played to midwicket for a single, they can do it with a run a ball
massive strike! Slogs across the line and makes superb contect, the length ball lands in the stands at deep midwicket, that's the telling blow
driven through cover, just the single, 12 to get off 7 balls
a full toss and Warner puts it away through cover, he didn't try and hit it too hard, just scooped it over the infield and placed it into the gap on the boundary
the new man Ojha plays the ball down the ground for a single

bowled him! Shukla delivers full and straight, Finch swings across the line and misses. Leg stump takes a beating. Delhi could pull off an unlikely win here! With Finch gone and Warner off strike, they have a new batsman to bowl to in a pressure situation.
hit down the ground for another single, Sunrisers need a boundary this over to take the pressure off
defended on the leg side
knocks it through midwicket for a single
a wide down leg side this time, the batsmen run after the keeper can't collect cleanly
steers the ball to third man for a single
hits a full toss straight down the ground
played down the ground for one more
played to midwicket for a single

works this away through square leg. But oh dear, he has slipped in his efforts to get a couple. The fielder in the deep has a pretty good chance of getting him out Warner is desperate enough to try a full length dive and he has reached safety
another one. He's trying to work Warner out with ones that angle in to keep that away swinger a surprise. Gets his direction off thoguh
slides this fuller one down the leg side

straightens off the deck as Kaul goes around the wicket. The angled lured Warner to poke at it but after pitching it darts away and he's soundly beaten. Warner practices a more straight batted punch through the covers

slapped it straight to one of the three men square on the off side! JP was at point, had to move a couple of steps to his left and holds on as Dhawan cuts one that didn't have as much room and didn't bother to keep it down.
comes down the track, but Kaul goes shorter and the ball jags back into him. Cramped for room, Dhawan looks to nudge through midwicket but the ball skews away behind point
goes for the cut, but this short of a length ball scoots under the bat
back of a length and just outside off, Finch covers the line to block but ends up getting an outside edge to third man
ripper to end the over. After a diet of short balls and the one darting back in, he gets one to seam away off the pitch. Dhawan was squared up and left groping
he was caught on off stump and had to work around his front pad in trying to flick the short of a good length ball. Gets stuck on the top of his pad. Appeal turned down, rightly
sways inside the line of this short ball pushed across him. Aha, and the umpire has called no-ball for height. KP's going up to the umpire to have a little chat.
this one doesn't rise and Dhawan pulls through the midwicket boundary. No real flourish as he concentrated on timing the ball
bouncer to greet the Sunrisers captain and he goes for the hook. Just a little too quick for him, but he had directed it down leg side and DK's leap can't pull it down
gets it off the bottom of the blade this time to the left of mid-off. Flat batted punch down the ground
expansive drive to start off but a little bit of nip away beats him. Back of a length delivery outside off
